## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
This review found no defects to fix. The new `--exclude` flag follows the project's `cli-flags` and `logging` skill rules. The added tests cover the single-pattern, multi-pattern, default and end-to-end archive paths.

## Changes
The pull request adds a repeatable `--exclude GLOB` flag to `cli/main.py`. `collect` uses it, through a new `is_excluded` helper, to skip files whose base name matches any pattern, and logs each skipped path. It also documents the flag in `docs/flags.md` and adds tests plus a text fixture under `tests/`.
